g.title: note
g.text: Arrows: consumer → dependency. Dashed: runtime or test use. Repeated/transitive edges are omitted.
Seventeen repositories are public; only FLASHApp is private. Readers and writers remain in Core.
ProSE and FLASH backend libraries link Core; Python does not load the CLI or GUI libraries.
This diagram describes package boundaries, not a self-contained runtime or completed FLASHApp deployment.
